eod.description: End-of-day research across major US equities for swing and next-session analysis.

intraday.name: Intraday
intraday.description: Short-term US equity research using intraday momentum, breakout and price-action conditions.

intraday.name: Intraday
intraday.description: Short-term UK equity research using intraday market conditions.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: Identifies stocks meeting the predefined momentum conditions.
momentum.entry_method: Wait for confirmation of the setup rather than entering solely because the stock appears in the scan.
momentum.exit_method: Reassess or exit when the setup invalidates or momentum conditions fail.

nr7.name: NR7
nr7.description: Identifies stocks showing a narrow-range setup based on the scanner's defined NR7 conditions.
nr7.entry_method: Wait for confirmation of the range expansion or breakout.
nr7.exit_method: Reassess if the breakout fails or the defined setup becomes invalid.

rathod_bullish.name: Rathod Bullish
rathod_bullish.description: Bullish candidates identified by the Rathod scanner conditions.
rathod_bullish.entry_method: Wait for confirmation of the bullish setup and define invalidation before entry.
rathod_bullish.exit_method: Exit or reassess when the setup invalidates.

dualbb_15m_bull.name: Dual BB 15m Bullish
dualbb_15m_bull.description: Bullish candidates identified by the Dual Bollinger Band 15-minute conditions.
dualbb_15m_bull.entry_method: Wait for confirmation of the 15-minute setup.
dualbb_15m_bull.exit_method: Reassess when the setup loses its defining conditions.

dualbb_15m_bear.name: Dual BB 15m Bearish
dualbb_15m_bear.description: Bearish candidates identified by the Dual Bollinger Band 15-minute conditions.
dualbb_15m_bear.entry_method: Wait for confirmation and appropriate risk definition before acting.
dualbb_15m_bear.exit_method: Reassess when the bearish setup invalidates.

dualbb_1h_bull.name: Dual BB 1h Bullish
dualbb_1h_bull.description: Bullish candidates identified by the Dual Bollinger Band 1-hour conditions.
dualbb_1h_bull.entry_method: Wait for confirmation of the 1-hour setup.
dualbb_1h_bull.exit_method: Reassess when the setup loses its defining conditions.

dualbb_1h_bear.name: Dual BB 1h Bearish
dualbb_1h_bear.description: Bearish candidates identified by the Dual Bollinger Band 1-hour conditions.
dualbb_1h_bear.entry_method: Wait for confirmation and appropriate risk definition before acting.
dualbb_1h_bear.exit_method: Reassess when the bearish setup invalidates.

bullbhai_momentum.name: BullBhai Momentum
bullbhai_momentum.description: Bullish momentum candidates identified by the BullBhai scanner.
bullbhai_momentum.entry_method: Wait for confirmation of the momentum setup.

short_term_breakout.name: Short Term Breakout
short_term_breakout.description: Stocks meeting the scanner's short-term breakout conditions.
short_term_breakout.entry_method: Wait for breakout confirmation and define invalidation.

potential_breakout.name: Potential Breakout
potential_breakout.description: Stocks identified as potential breakout candidates by the scanner.
potential_breakout.entry_method: Treat as a watchlist candidate until breakout confirmation occurs.
potential_breakout.exit_method: Remove or reassess if the breakout setup deteriorates.

buy_breakout_100.name: 100% Buy Breakout
buy_breakout_100.description: Stocks identified by the scanner's 100% buy breakout condition.
buy_breakout_100.entry_method: Review the breakout and confirmation conditions before considering entry.
buy_breakout_100.exit_method: Use the defined setup invalidation rather than relying on the scan alone.

possible_bottom_out.name: Possible Bottom Out
possible_bottom_out.description: Stocks identified by the scanner as possible bottoming candidates.
possible_bottom_out.entry_method: Treat as research/watchlist candidates and wait for confirmation.
possible_bottom_out.exit_method: Reassess if the bottoming thesis or technical setup fails.

option_sell.name: Option Sell
option_sell.description: Candidates identified by the option-selling scanner.
option_sell.entry_method: Requires separate option-risk analysis and confirmation.
option_sell.exit_method: Use predefined risk limits and invalidate the underlying setup when appropriate.
